## CachePolicy

Exact-prefix completion caching for one API token. Absent on the permission  means the token is never served from cache and never populates one.

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` (`enabled`) | 1 | `bool` | implicit default |  |
| `scope` (`scope`) | 2 | [`CacheScope`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#cachescope) | implicit default |  |
| `ttl_secs` (`ttlSecs`) | 3 | `uint64` | optional |  |
| `max_entry_bytes` (`maxEntryBytes`) | 4 | `uint64` | optional |  |

## ApiKeyConnectionScope

Direct model ids a key may call on one connection. Never grants a chalk/*  model route; those are granted by ApiKeyRouteScope.

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection_id` (`connectionId`) | 1 | `string` | implicit default |  |
| `models` (`models`) | 2 | `string` | repeated | Public model ids. Empty means any direct model on this connection. |

## ApiKeyRouteRef

Select one model route by its immutable id or its public model id (for  example, chalk/assistant-pro). Public ids are resolved in the key's environment  when the permission is written; stored grants and responses use route_id.  Deleting and recreating a public id never carries an existing grant over.

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `route_id` (`routeId`) | 1 | `string` | oneof `identifier` |  |
| `public_model_id` (`publicModelId`) | 2 | `string` | oneof `identifier` |  |

## ApiKeyRouteScope

A grant covers everything the route dispatches to: its default target, judge  classifier and outcomes, and its own fallbacks, on any connection.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refs` (`refs`) | 1 | [`ApiKeyRouteRef`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#apikeyrouteref) | repeated |  |

## ApiKeyPermission

What a key may call. With neither routes nor connection_scopes set, any  model. Otherwise the union of the granted routes and the direct models the  connection scopes allow; present but empty routes with no connection scopes  allow nothing. Responses always set routes on a restricted key.

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` (`provider`) | 1 | `string` | optional; deprecated | Legacy fields. Requests that set them are rejected rather than ignored, so  an older client cannot create an unrestricted key by accident. Responses  never set them; a stored key that carries them is returned with them  folded into connection_scopes. |
| `models` (`models`) | 2 | `string` | repeated; deprecated |  |
| `connection_id` (`connectionId`) | 3 | `string` | optional; deprecated |  |
| `downgradable` (`downgradable`) | 4 | `bool` | optional |  |
| `model_floor` (`modelFloor`) | 5 | `string` | optional |  |
| `connection_scopes` (`connectionScopes`) | 6 | [`ApiKeyConnectionScope`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#apikeyconnectionscope) | repeated |  |
| `cache` (`cache`) | 7 | [`CachePolicy`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#cachepolicy) | optional |  |
| `routes` (`routes`) | 8 | [`ApiKeyRouteScope`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#apikeyroutescope) | optional |  |

## CacheScope

How widely one cached completion may be reused. Every scope is already  partitioned by model and by Chalk environment; this chooses the tenancy  partition on top of that. UNSPECIFIED is treated as TOKEN — the narrowest  scope — so a client that omits the field never widens disclosure by accident.

| Name | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CACHE_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `CACHE_SCOPE_MODEL` | 1 |  |
| `CACHE_SCOPE_TEAM` | 2 |  |
| `CACHE_SCOPE_TOKEN` | 3 |  |

## UsageSource

Provenance of the token counts persisted for one usage event. Database  SMALLINT values use these exact enum numbers; UNSPECIFIED is never stored.

| Name | Number | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `USAGE_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `USAGE_SOURCE_REPORTED` | 1 |  |
| `USAGE_SOURCE_ESTIMATED` | 2 |  |
| `USAGE_SOURCE_LEGACY_UNKNOWN` | 3 |  |
